description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Beach Home!* 5-Minute Walk to the Beach!* Private Pool and Spa- Pool Heating Available (add'l $50/night fee, can only be heated for 3 hours/day)* 2 Complimentary Bikes* Outdoor TV and Grill plus Large Screened-In Front Porch * Beach Gear Included – Beach chairs, umbrellas, toys, and a wagon are provided* Kid Friendly- Small table and chairs, beach toys, and games for younger guests* 1 Mile to Alys Beach and The Big Chill and 2 Miles to Rosemary Beach * Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. ** Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, pool/spa heater controls, a decibel meter, and video surveillance, including the front door and pool area.*Welcome to Front Porch Sitting, a beautiful family-friendly beach home in Seacrest designed for making unforgettable 30A memories! Located just a short walk from the beach with a fantastic private pool, spa and screened-in porch. Step outside to your private backyard spacious deck, it offers plenty of room where you can spend sunny afternoons swimming in the pool or relaxing in the spa. Fire up the grill, turn on the outdoor TV, and enjoy a relaxing evening without ever leaving home. Inside, Front Porch Sitting offers a comfortable layout with three bedrooms, two bathrooms, and sleeping accommodations for up to 10 guests. The fully equipped kitchen and dining area make family meals easy, while the comfortable living space provides a place to unwind after a day at the beach. A master bedroom features plush King mattresses, and a guest bedroom with a king bed, while the bunk room includes Twin-over-Full Bunk Bed + Twin Trundle. The living room also features a Queen pull-out sleeper sofa for additional sleeping space. The large screened-in front porch provides another wonderful gathering space with plenty of seating. Front Porch Sitting is the perfect place for your next family beach vacation.The Bed Setup:Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: King BedBunk Room: Twin-over-Full Bunk Bed + Twin TrundleLiving Room: Queen Sleeper SofaArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
